Michelle Generoo

Fox Mulder

Michelle Generoo

I don't know. I may. Two weeks ago a shuttle mission was scrubbed three seconds before lift-off when an auxiliary power unit valve malfunctioned. If the flight had not been aborted there was a great chance the liquid fuel system and the orbiter would have exploded on the launch pad. This was sent to me in the mail. It's a material analysis that shows deep-grooved scoring marks inside this a.p.u. Valve-- marks that could have caused a malfunction.

Fox Mulder

Evidence of tampering?

Michelle Generoo

That's what it looks like, but... According to the person who gave me your names you have expertise in unexplained phenomena. And what's unexplainable is how anybody could have done it.

Dana Scully

How do you mean?

Michelle Generoo

Dana Scully

Do you have any idea who sent that to you?

Michelle Generoo

No idea. The official analysis of the malfunction was simple mechanical failure.

Fox Mulder

Does anybody share your suspicions?

Michelle Generoo

If they do they're not talking to the FBI I believe in the space program and the people who run it but there's another launch window tomorrow. My reasons may sound selfish, but my fiance is a shuttle commander on that mission.
